spans.notes: 18 frames: a teal retro television on a wooden cabinet showing scrolling credits text on its screen; no lead (also no_lead)

spans.view: with a cream sofa behind them and the back of a teal television blurred in the foreground

beats.text: Polly snuggles against Pax's shoulder with her eyes closed while Pax sits under a checkered blanket beside her, blinking and glancing at her
Pax closes his eyes with a contented look while Polly dozes against him under the blanket
Pax opens his eyes and wriggles sideways out from under the blanket, leaving Polly asleep beneath it
Pax sits on the front edge of the sofa with his feet dangling, looking at the sleeping Polly
Pax spreads his flippers and hops down off the sofa onto the floor, shutting his eyes as he jumps
Pax stands in front of the sofa while Polly slumps sideways onto the cushions, still asleep
Pax turns his back and leans over Polly lying on the sofa, gathering the blanket around her

No static run. Pax leans forward and lays Polly down on the bed, still wrapped in the blanket and asleep
